# Experiment index

*Generated by `tools/gen_experiment_index.py` from the source. 193 apps, 266 runnable entrypoints. Regenerate after adding an entrypoint; do not hand-edit.*

Every experiment runs as `modal run modal_apps/<app>::<entrypoint>`.
Long runs must add `--detach` (a laptop suspend kills an attached run).

## `apply_provenance_overlays_app.py`

  ```
  modal run modal_apps/apply_provenance_overlays_app.py::main --commit --packed-root --mmp-root --audit-pack-completion-sha256 --mmp-pack-completion-sha256
  ```

## `committor_bellman_app.py`
Fitted finite-horizon structural committor by Bellman recursion.

- **`screen`** — STAGE 1: screen many regions for short-horizon reachability.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::screen --per-molecule 30 --batch 12 --train-lo 6 --train-hi 22
  ```
- **`harvest`** — Rebuild the local screen mirror from the volume after a client death.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::harvest --train-lo 6 --train-hi 22
  ```
- **`mixture`** — STAGE 2: collect the mixture replay set, gate it, then fit.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::mixture --neg-per-pos 2 --sat-zero 12 --max-b 6 --epochs 400 --train-lo 6 --train-hi 22
  ```
- **`screen_dude`** — Screen the fresh DUD-E holdout pool -- SAME DISTRIBUTION as the dev seeds.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::screen_dude --batch 4 --per-molecule 2 --n-molecules 60 --offset 0 --subdir screen_dude
  ```
- **`exec_check`** — CONDITIONAL execution efficiency, not a reachability-rate benchmark.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::exec_check --budget-calls 6000 --max-trials 400 --n-regions 12 --src diagnostics/screen_screen_pool.json
  ```
- **`budget_probe`** — Calibration probe: how much does apparent reachability depend on B?
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::budget_probe --subdir budget_probe
  ```
- **`rescreen_reachable`** — Re-screen the regions the PRE-FIX screen called reachable.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::rescreen_reachable --batch 2 --subdir rescreen
  ```
- **`screen_pool`** — Screen the fresh benchmark-disjoint pool with the corrected kernel.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::screen_pool --batch 4 --per-molecule 2 --n-molecules 150 --subdir screen_pool
  ```
- **`pool_status`** — Read the running pool screen off the volume and apply the stop gate.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::pool_status --subdir screen_pool
  ```
- **`screen_heldout`** — STAGE A of the held-out protocol: screen EVERY eligible region on the
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::screen_heldout --batch 4 --test-lo 0 --test-hi 6
  ```
- **`rank`** — STAGE B: conditional ranking, on reachable held-out regions only.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::rank --max-regions 0
  ```
- **`arms_report`** — Report the arm comparison from whatever is persisted on the volume.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::arms_report
  ```
- **`arms`** — End-to-end: does tilting by the frozen committor buy complete region
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::arms --budget-calls 20000 --max-trials 2000 --limit 0
  ```
- **`verify_cache`** — Prove the memoized successor path is bit-identical before using it.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::verify_cache --n 6 --depth 3 --revisits 3
  ```
- **`verify_law`** — GATE 1 report: cached law == uncached law, bitwise.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::verify_law --n 10 --depth 3 --revisits 3
  ```
- **`profile_attempt`** — Measure what ONE full attempt actually costs post-cache-fix, on 1-2
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::profile_attempt --max-calls 4000 --n 2
  ```
- **`race`** — STAGE: independent attempts, paired by (region, seed), one wave.
  ```
  modal run modal_apps/committor_bellman_app.py::race --seeds 2 --seed0 1 --max-calls 4150 --n-regions 16
  ```
